notes: Second real Edco sample, distinct account (819387 vs 077087) and a distinct account-suffix letter (-3R vs -3A), added to confirm the vendor_account_number generalization (063df59) and the mid_line remit_address fix (727b25c) hold on data neither fix was tuned against. No F1 trap here: a same-statement PAYMENT -- THANK YOU (08/27, 3380.67) exactly offsets BALANCE FORWARD (3380.67), so the carried balance is 0.00 and amount_payable == total_printed == current_charges, no ambiguity. This document surfaces three pre-existing, already-tracked Edco extraction gaps (same class as northstar-edco-077087's known failures, not new bugs from this label): (1) the persona has no selector for the payment line, so fields.payments_credits will read null against this label's -3380.67; (2) the persona has no line-item ladder at all, so line_items.count/amounts will read 0 against this label's 11 rows; (3) bill_to_attention is not separated from bill_to_address (folded together in the real record), same as 077087. A fourth, NEW observation: expected_routing.review_flag is asserted false because the arithmetic closes cleanly (validate_gold.py's closure rule), but the real pipeline currently returns review_flag=true / lane=medium because total_printed's selector confidence (0.90) sits below Edco's own 0.95 threshold for that field (packs/northstar/thresholds.py) - a confidence-calibration gap, not a page-role issue, and not something this label authoring fixes.
